scope: Supplied renders and source evidence only; no geometry/runtime verification

findings.finding: Low rounded woven bowl, bound rim and one tall continuous carrying arch preserve the source identity. Empty cavity contains no inferred goods.
Oblique cavity is clear. No consequential strand intrusion or detached floating piece is visible. Exterior warp/weft reads as attached continuous woven surface.
Both arch ends meet the rim/wall, with small binding marks at the junctions. Arch and bound rim are visually continuous in the supplied south, north and oblique views.
East is a physically edge-on carrying arch over the same bowl; south/north retain the full arch. These are consistent authoring views, not evidence of extra native map states.

At supplied 16x24, 24x36 and 32x48 comparisons, south/north preserve the arch-and-low-bowl silhouette. Weave becomes tonal texture at 16x24, with better courses at larger sizes. East loses the arch opening as expected edge-on; it is an authoring view.

Small dark seams and short binding ends at rim/handle joins, and slight unevenness at the bottom strand termination, are visible at master scale. They do not read as contents, separate floating pieces, or consequential small-scale defects.

limitations: Visual structural recommendation only. No mesh topology, native activation, runtime, palette ownership or delivery validation performed.
